<bole-experience>
Use this experience only when applicable: Use when a task requires a daemon, server, listener, or other background process to remain running after the agent exits.
A process started through the bash tool's run_in_background job registry is owned by the agent session and may be stopped during session cleanup. If the final artifact is a live service that a verifier will probe after the agent exits, launch it from a foreground shell call as a detached OS session, for example with `nohup setsid <command> </dev/null >/tmp/<name>.log 2>&1 &`. Record its PID, then use a separate shell call to verify both the process and the externally visible port or protocol. Use managed background jobs only for temporary work that should end with the agent session.
</bole-experience>
